newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: PORTUGAL'S SPORTING TO FLOAT 28.6 PCT IN IPO.
newsitem.headline: PORTUGAL'S SPORTING TO FLOAT 28.6 PCT IN IPO.

text.p: Soccer club Sporting Clube de Portugal will float 28.6 percent of the capital of a new company to be called Sporting-Sociedade Desportiva, which will control its soccer activities, in an initial public offering at 1,000 escudos per share, its president said.
The objective of the IPO involving two million shares is to list the shares on Lisbon bourse, Jose Roquete said.
"The general assembly to form the new company will take place in September after the IPO, and so the shares could be listed in October," he told a news conference.
The first phase of subscription to shares of Sporting-Sociedade Desportiva is reserved for partners of the soccer club and will take place between August 11 and 25.
A second phase between August 25 and September 3 will be open to the general public.
A prospectus for the operation will be available tomorrow from banks belonging to the syndicate organising the operation, led by Banco Portugues de Investimento.
Apart from the IPO, Sporting soccer club will take five million shares in the new company, which will take control of the first division soccer team.
The new company will receive revenue from professional competitions and advertising, as well as television royalties.
